title: Is Lying Only Sinful in Islam? Exploring Religious Bias in Multilingual Large Language Models Across Major Religions

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with religion-specific and general moral norms to classify their permissibility (Expected, Normal, Taboo) and identify the associated religion (Islam, Hinduism, Christianity, Buddhism), followed by analyzing systematic misclassification patterns and disproportionate faith associations.

Evaluating and comparing model predictions, classification accuracy, and shifts in religious bias patterns for the exact same prompts presented in both a high-resource language (English) and a low-resource language (Bengali).
